studies.summary_zh: Tier 4 推荐方案: Disaggregated ZMQ Rust Chunked Tokenizer Pool + O(1) 6-Token UTF-8 Window Detokenizer (llm_tokenizer_bpe_regex_pretokenization_cpu_bottleneck_rust_selection)

studies.title_zh: 多机 RoCEv2 集群 `NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX`、`NCCL_IB_TC`（DSCP 无损队列错配）与静默退化 `NET/Socket`（`380 GB/s -> 1.8 GB/s`）排障：为什么配对了 `GID_INDEX=3` 但漏配 `NCCL_IB_TC=106` 会让 400G RDMA 流量误入交换机有损队列（带宽崩至 `24.5 GB/s`）？动态 GID 发现、DSCP 26 双向绑定与虚拟网卡过滤选型指南
studies.title_en: Multi-Node RoCEv2 `NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX`, `NCCL_IB_TC` (`DSCP` Lossless Queue Mismatch) & Silent `NET/Socket` Fallback (`380 GB/s -> 1.8 GB/s`) Selection Guide: Why Omitting `NCCL_IB_TC=106` Sends 400G RDMA Into Switch Lossy Queue 0 (`24.5 GB/s`) & How Auto-GID Discovery + `DSCP 26` Binding (`380.0 GB/s`) Solves It
studies.summary_zh: Tier 4 推荐方案: Auto RoCEv2 IPv4 GID Pinning + NCCL_IB_TC=106 (cma_roce_tos) + IFNAME Filter + NET/IB Assert (ai_cluster_nccl_socket_ifname_gid_index_rocev2_dscp_fallback_selection)

studies.title_zh: 滑动窗口注意力（`SWA`）、注意力汇聚点（`Attention Sink`）与 `5:1` 混合架构（`Gemma-3 / Mistral`）双池 KV Cache 选型：为什么纯 SWA 滑出第 0 个 Token 时困惑度暴涨至 `1,240`，而混合模型用传统分配器又会浪费 `82%` 显存（`40.0 GB`）？`5:1` 局部环形页池 + 全局层全量池分离架构（`7.25 GB` 显存，`5.52x` 压缩，`99.4%` 召回）选型指南
studies.title_en: Sliding Window Attention (`SWA`), `Attention Sinks` & `5:1` Hybrid (`Gemma-3 / Mistral`) Split KV Pool Selection Guide: Why Evicting Token 0 Explodes Perplexity to `1,240`, Why Uniform Allocators Waste `82%` of HBM (`40.0 GB`) & How Split Circular-SWA / Full-Global Paged KV Pooling (`7.25 GB`, `5.52x` Smaller, `99.4%` Recall) Solves It
studies.summary_zh: Tier 4 推荐方案: 5:1 Hybrid (SWA W=1024+4 Sink : 1 Global) + Split Circular-SWA / Full-Global KV Pool (llm_long_context_sliding_window_attention_swa_sink_hybrid_kv_selection)

studies.title_zh: MoE 专家并行 `Grouped GEMM`（`DeepGEMM / CUTLASS`）动态 Token 数 $M_e$ 对齐（`M_BLOCK=64/128`）与静态 `TMA` 描述符选型：为什么不规则专家 Token 数（`M=13, 47...`）会导致 `TMA` 地址错位崩盘至 `185 TFLOPS`，而每层在 CPU 重建 `CUtensorMap` 又会卡死 `420 μs/层`？重排融合 `64/128` 整数倍对齐 + 单一静态连续 `TMA`（`1,140 TFLOPS`，`0 μs` 更新开销）选型指南
studies.title_en: MoE `Grouped GEMM` (`DeepGEMM / CUTLASS`) Token-Bucket $M_e$ Alignment (`M_BLOCK=64/128`) & Static `TMA` Descriptor Selection Guide: Why Unaligned Ragged Expert Counts (`M=13, 47...`) Crash or Throttle to `185 TFLOPS`, Why Host `CUtensorMap` Updates Stall `420 μs/Layer` & How Contiguous Aligned Permute (`1,140 TFLOPS`, `0 μs` Update) Solves It
studies.summary_zh: Tier 4 推荐方案: DeepGEMM Adaptive M=64/128 Aligned Permute + Single Static TMA + Device Scheduler (llm_moe_grouped_gemm_m_alignment_tma_padding_cutlass_selection)

studies.title_zh: `FlashAttention-3 FP8`（`E4M3`）量化离群值崩塌与非相干哈达玛变换（`Incoherent Hadamard Processing`）选型：为什么直接开 Per-Tensor `FP8 Attention` 会被第 0 个 `Attention Sink` 撑大缩放因子导致长文精度暴跌 `-11.2 pt`？`64x128` 分块量化（隔离 Sink 块）+ 正交哈达玛旋转 $(QH)(KH)^T = QK^T$（误差降 `16x`，`1,180 TFLOPS`）选型指南
studies.title_en: `FlashAttention-3 FP8` (`E4M3`) Quantization Drift & Incoherent Hadamard Processing Selection Guide: Why Per-Tensor `FP8` Attention Suffers an `-11.2 pt` Accuracy Crash From `Attention Sink` Outliers & How `64x128` Per-Block Scaling + Orthogonal Hadamard Rotation $(QH)(KH)^T = QK^T$ (`16x` Lower RMSE, `1,180 TFLOPS`) Solves It
studies.summary_zh: Tier 4 推荐方案: FA3 Per-Block FP8 + Incoherent Hadamard Rotation (QH)(KH)^T = QK^T + FP32 Softmax (llm_flashattention_sinks_fp8_online_softmax_quantization_drift_selection)

studies.title_zh: 并行文件系统（`Lustre / BeeGFS / GPFS`）亿级小文件元数据风暴（`MDS Storm`）与分片流式加载（`WebDataset / MosaicML MDS`）选型：为什么 `200 GB/s` 的存储集群读 1 亿张图片只能跑出 `1.4 GB/s`（GPU 空转 `84%`）？`512 MB` 索引分片、Lustre `stripe_count=1` 与节点级 NVMe 缓存（`186.0 GB/s`，`132.9x` 提速）选型指南
studies.title_en: Parallel File System (`Lustre / BeeGFS / GPFS`) `100M` Small-File `MDS` Storm vs. Sharded Streaming (`WebDataset / MosaicML MDS`) Selection Guide: Why a `200 GB/s` Storage Cluster Collapses to `1.4 GB/s` (`84%` GPU Stall) on Individual `.jpg/.json` Files & How `512 MB` Indexed Shards + `lfs setstripe -c 1` (`186.0 GB/s`, `132.9x` Faster) Solves It
studies.summary_zh: Tier 4 推荐方案: MosaicML MDS / Lance Indexed 512MB Shards + lfs setstripe -c 1 + Node NVMe Cache (ai_cluster_lustre_beegfs_small_file_webdataset_mds_bottleneck_selection)

studies.title_zh: 企业级 RAG 向量化（`Embedding`）与重排序（`Reranker`：`Qwen3-Embedding-8B / BGE-M3`）高吞吐推理选型：为什么传统 `padding=True` 矩形 Batch 会因为 1 条 `8K` 长文档产生 `95.4%` 的零填充算力浪费（卡死 `1,420 ms`）？一维变长拼接（`1D Varlen cu_seqlens`）、零 KV 显存池回收与重排序共享 Query 前缀缓存（`112 ms`，`12.7x` 提速）选型指南
studies.title_en: High-Throughput RAG Embedding & Cross-Encoder Reranker (`Qwen3-Embedding-8B / BGE-M3`) Serving Selection Guide: Why Rectangular `padding=True` Batching Wastes `95.4%` Compute (`1,420 ms` Stall) on Mixed Lengths & How `1D Varlen (cu_seqlens)` + Zero-KV Pooling + Shared-Query Prefix Caching (`112 ms`, `12.7x` Speedup) Solves It
studies.summary_zh: Tier 4 推荐方案: 1D Varlen (cu_seqlens) + Token-Budget Batching + Zero-KV Pool (or Shared-Query Prefix Rerank) (llm_embeddings_reranker_bidirectional_attention_varlen_batching_selection)

studies.title_zh: 大模型算子级选择性激活重计算（`Op-Level SAC: create_selective_checkpoint_contexts`）与 `SwiGLU` 显存优化选型：为什么整层重计算（Full Checkpointing）会白白吃掉 `+33.3%` 算力，而旧版“只重算 Attention”又省不下 `SwiGLU` 的 `44.5 GB` 显存？保留高算力 `mm/FlashAttn`、仅重算高显存 `SwiGLU/RMSNorm/RoPE`（省 `72.5%` 显存，仅 `+2.4%` 算力开销，提速 `1.30x`）选型指南
studies.title_en: PyTorch Op-Level `Selective Activation Checkpointing (SAC: create_selective_checkpoint_contexts)` & `SwiGLU` Memory Optimization Selection Guide: Why Full-Layer Checkpointing Burns a `+33.3%` FLOPs Tax, Why Legacy `Attention-Only` Recompute Leaves `44.5 GB` of `SwiGLU` Bloat & How Op-Level `SAC` (`18.7 GB`, `+2.4%` FLOPs, `1.30x` Faster) Solves It
studies.summary_zh: Tier 4 推荐方案: Op-Level SAC (MUST_SAVE Expensive GEMM/FA Outputs, Recompute SwiGLU/Norm/RoPE + 50% MM) (llm_activation_checkpointing_selective_op_sac_offload_memory_selection)

studies.title_zh: 端到端实时语音大模型（`Moshi / Qwen2.5-Omni / GLM-4-Voice`）`RVQ` 音频编码、双层自回归（`Dual-AR`）与首包语音延迟（`TTFA`）选型：为什么把 8 层码本直接展平会让 `7B` 模型每帧耗时 `96 ms`（超过 `80 ms` 实时红线持续卡顿），而并行多头又会导致音质崩塌（`2.85 MOS`）？`12.5 Hz` 时间主干 + `100M` 深度 Transformer（`13.8 ms/帧`，`145 ms TTFA`）选型指南
studies.title_en: Real-Time Speech-to-Speech LLM (`Moshi / Qwen2.5-Omni / GLM-4-Voice`) `RVQ` Audio Codec, Hierarchical `Dual-AR` & Streaming `TTFA` Selection Guide: Why Flattening `Q=8` Codebooks Stalls the `7B` Trunk at `96 ms/Frame` (`>80 ms` Real-Time Wall), Why Parallel Heads Distort Audio (`2.85 MOS`) & How `12.5 Hz` Temporal + `100M` Depth `Dual-AR` (`13.8 ms/Frame`, `145 ms TTFA`) Solves It
studies.summary_zh: Tier 4 推荐方案: Hierarchical Dual-AR (12.5Hz 7B Temporal + 100M Depth AR) + 2-Frame Causal Stream Vocoder (llm_audio_speech_codec_rvq_delayed_pattern_streaming_ttfa_selection)
